Name: Community Contracts
Author: KrigerJ
Description:
[b][size=4]Community Contracts v2.1.3[/size][/b]

Turn Stardew Valley into a thriving cooperative economy by partnering with townspeople through contracts, automation, and on‑demand services. Version [b]2.1.3[/b] is the largest expansion since the mod’s creation — introducing powerful combat utilities, centralized processing, new automation systems, improved UI navigation, and expanded service options. This update builds on the streamlined, dialogue‑free workflow of v2.1.2 while adding entirely new layers of gameplay depth.

[b][size=4]Getting Started[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] if you haven’t already.[/*]
[*]Download and install [b]Community Contracts[/b].[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley and press [b]V[/b] to open the Community Contracts Toolbar.[/*]
[*]You can change the hotkey anytime from the [b]Settings Menu[/b] on the toolbar.[/*]
[*]All features, services, and configuration options are accessible directly from the toolbar.
See the Getting Started video [url=https://youtu.be/X-jR8DMylaM]HERE[/url].[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]What’s New in v2.1.3[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Shockwave Bombs (Combat + Mining Utility)[/size][/b]
Unleash a customizable shockwave that damages monsters and breaks rocks in the mines
[list]
[*]Toggle Shockwave mode directly from the toolbar[/*]
[*]Shockwave originates from the point where you left‑click while holding your weapon[/*]
[*]Powered by items stored in your [b]Fuel Locker[/b][/*]
[*]Each blast consumes one fuel item[/*]
[*]Shockwave radius and damage scales with:
[list]
[*]NPC friendship levels[/*]
[*]The value of fuel items [/*]
[*]Use higher‑value fuel to create devastating shockwaves.[/*]
[*]Friendship with Kent increases shockwave power and radius[/*]
[*]Use caution since an accidental large scale explosion can devastate your farm![/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Warp Service (Custom Warp Library)[/size][/b]
Create and manage your own warp‑to locations.
[list]
[*]Save custom warp points anywhere in the world[/*]
[*]Add warp points to Skull Cavern levels to preserve progress[/*]
[*]All warp locations are stored in your config file and persist across saves and new farms. Build a personal fast‑travel network tailored to your play style[/*]
[*]See the demonstration video [url=https://youtu.be/SPUEwrf5Mbk]HERE[/url][/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]Centralized Processing Service[/size][/b][/heading]
All raw‑goods processing is now unified into a single service
[list]
[*]Recycling[/*]
[*]Juicing[/*]
[*]Pickling[/*]
[*]Sashimi[/*]
[*]Ore processing [/*]
[*]Run everything at once with one contract[/*]
[*]Choose delivery to your [b]Delivery Chest[/b] or directly to the [b]Shipping Bin[/b][/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]Processing Chest (High‑Capacity Input Storage)[/size][/b][/heading]
A dedicated chest for all raw goods used in processing services.
[list]
[*]Frees up backpack space[/*]
[*]Simplifies automation management[/*]
[*]Supports:
[list]
[*]Recycling[/*]
[*]Juicing[/*]
[*]Pickling[/*]
[*]Sashimi[/*]
[*]Ore processing[/*]
[*]Seed making[/*]
[*]Crab pot baiting [/*]
[*]The Processing Chest becomes your centralized hub for all raw materials[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]Improved Character Menu (Scrolling Support)[/size][/b][/heading]
The Character Menu now supports scrolling via:
[list]
[*]Mouse wheel[/*]
[*]Keyboard up/down arrows [/*]
[*]This makes navigating large NPC lists smoother and more intuitive[/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]Enhanced Delivery Options[/size][/b][/heading]
Collecting services now allow you to choose whether NPCs deliver:
[list]
[*]Raw goods[/*]
[*]Processed goods[/*]
[*]To your Delivery Chest[/*]
[*]To your Shipping Bin[/*]
[/list][heading][b][size=4]Animal Care Service[/size][/b][/heading]
Hire a character to:
[list]
[*]Feed your animals[/*]
[*]Pet your animals [/*]
[*]A fully automated livestock‑care workflow[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Recycling Service[/size][/b]
Hire a character to recycle trash items for you — fully integrated with the Processing Chest
[list]
[*]Joja Cola is turned into vinegar[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Rock Candy Manufacturing[/b] [/size]
Rock Candy becomes a powerful new manufacturing option.
[list]
[*]Hire a character to manufacture Rock Candy using items in your Processing Chest[/*]
[*]Total item value must meet or exceed the value of one Rock Candy[/*]
[*]Any leftover value is given to the NPC as a tip [/*]
[*]Rock Candy remains a universal favorite gift and a powerful consumable[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Combat Shielding [/size][/b]
Enable [b]Shielding[/b] in Community Contracts Settings to gain daily monster‑damage protection
[list]
[*]Pay a small daily fee[/*]
[*]Shielding HP scales with total friendship points[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Return Damage [/size][/b]
Enable [b]Return Damage[/b] to reflect a portion of incoming monster damage back to nearby enemies
[list]
[*]Pay a small daily fee[/*]
[*]Damage reflection scales with total friendship points[/*]
[*]Creates a small explosion centered on enemies in the proximity[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Features Carried Forward from v2.1.2[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Dialogue‑Free Workflow[/size][/b]
All services are accessed through the toolbar — no NPC clicking, no dialogue interruptions, no broken conversations.

[b][size=4]Improved Toolbar + Settings Menu[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Dedicated settings panel[/*]
[*]Hotkey customization[/*]
[*]Cleaner navigation[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Universal NPC Support [/size][/b]
All villagers (including modded NPCs) appear in the Character Menu with:
[list]
[*]Friendship points[/*]
[*]NPC level[/*]
[*]Automatic sorting (highest → lowest friendship)[/*]
[*]Sorting can also be changed to lowest to highest friendship levels[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Animal Product Processing[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Eggs → Mayo[/*]
[*]Milk → Cheese[/*]
[*]Wool → Cloth[/*]
[*]Truffles → Oil [/*]
[*]Works across all farm buildings and pulls from Processing Chest + Autograbbers[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Juicing Service[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Fruit, vegetables, select forageables → Juice[/*]
[*]Quality preserved[/*]
[*]Output scales with item value[/*]
[*]Always profitable[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Direct Delivery to Shipping Bin[/size][/b]
Choose Delivery Chest or Shipping Bin for processed goods. 

[b][size=4]Multiple Workers for Large Jobs [/size][/b]

Parallel NPC processing for:
[list]
[*]Large harvests[/*]
[*]Big processing batches[/*]
[*]High‑volume automation tasks[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Features Carried Forward from previous versions, and updated:[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Farming Services[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Planting[/*]
[*]Tilling[/*]
[*]Watering[/*]
[*]Garden Pot placement[/*]
[*]Bee House placement[/*]
[*]Honey collection + optional mead processing[/*]
[*]Animal care[/*]
[*]Seed making[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Other Services[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Sashimi making[/*]
[*]Ore processing[/*]
[*]Reliable crop harvesting[/*]
[*]Smarter crab pot placement, baiting, and harvesting[/*]
[*]Adjustable rectangular service areas[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Core Systems[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Delivery chest with customizable colors + labels[/*]
[*]Contract growth tied to friendship + skill[/*]
[*]Specialist and non‑specialist NPC roles[/*]
[*]Optional processor time reduction[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Summary[/b][/size]
Community Contracts v2.1.3 is a major expansion that introduces powerful combat utilities, centralized processing, improved automation, and new service options — all while preserving the streamlined, dialogue‑free workflow introduced in v2.1.2. Whether you’re running a small homestead or a massive industrial farm, this update makes NPC collaboration deeper, faster, and more immersive than ever.
